	# Path to parent folder
	parentPath = tagPath.replace("/AlarmState","/Alarms/")
	
	# Get the count of alarm tags in parent folder
	results = system.tag.browse(path = parentPath, filter = {'name':'*M*'})
	maxalarmcount = len(results) + 1
	
	# Generate list of tagpaths
	tstamptagPaths = [parentPath + 'Alarm{0}/State.Timestamp'.format(tag) for tag in range(1,maxalarmcount)]
	statetagPaths = [parentPath + 'Alarm{0}/State'.format(tag) for tag in range(1,maxalarmcount)]
	alarmcodetagPaths = [parentPath + 'Alarm{0}/AlarmCode'.format(tag) for tag in range(1,maxalarmcount)]
	
	# Genreate list of tag values
	tstampevalues = system.tag.readBlocking(tstamptagPaths)
	statevalues = system.tag.readBlocking(statetagPaths)
	alarmcodevalues = system.tag.readBlocking(alarmcodetagPaths)
	
	# Define dataset
	headers = ['tstamp','state','alarmcode']
	data = []
	
	# Combine all list into a new dataset, sort values based on time stamp and state
	for i in range(len(tstampevalues)):
		row = [tstampevalues[i].value,statevalues[i].value ,alarmcodevalues[i].value]
		data.append(row)
		datalist = system.dataset.toDataSet(headers,data)
		tempsorteddata = system.dataset.sort(datalist,'tstamp',1)
		sorteddata = system.dataset.sort(tempsorteddata ,'state',0)
	
	# Determine if oldest alarm is active and write active alarm code to tag, if not than write zero
	state = sorteddata.getValueAt(0, 1)
	activealarmcode = sorteddata.getValueAt(0, 2)
	if state:
		system.tag.write(activealarmcodepath,activealarmcode)
	else:
		system.tag.write(activealarmcodepath,0)

# Description: Adjusts the format of the "poNumber" tag value by prefixing it with "000"
#              and writes it back to the same tag whenever its value changes.

    """
    This function triggers when the value of the tag changes.
    It reads the current value of the "poNumber" tag, prefixes it with "000",
    and writes the updated value back to the tag.
    
    Args:
        tag (object): Tag object whose value changed.
        tagPath (str): The full path of the tag.
        previousValue (QualifiedValue): The previous value of the tag.
        currentValue (QualifiedValue): The new value of the tag.
        initialChange (bool): True if this is the first time the script is triggered.
        missedEvents (int): Number of missed events since the script last ran.
    """
